A second home for little learners

Since 2020, Holy Kids Pre-School has welcomed children with warmth, patience and joy. Our colourful classrooms, caring teachers and play-led lessons help every child grow in confidence, curiosity and kindness.

“Every child is a seed of greatness. Our job is to give them sunshine, love and room to grow.”

Classes for every little step

English medium learning with day care available.

Sports

Running, jumping, ball games and team play build strong bodies, good balance and a happy spirit. Our children learn to cheer for friends and to try again with a smile.

  • Races
  • Ball games
  • Yoga
  • Sports day

Arts & Craft

Drawing, painting, paper folding and clay work let imagination run free. Their colourful creations hang proudly on our walls and go home with big smiles.

  • Drawing
  • Painting
  • Paper craft
  • Clay play

Studies

Play-based lessons in English, numbers, rhymes, stories and the world around us. Small steps and lots of encouragement make learning feel like a game.

  • English
  • Numbers
  • Rhymes
  • Story time

Tuitions

Extra guidance in a calm, friendly setting. Our teachers give personal attention to reading, writing and homework so every child feels confident.

  • Reading
  • Writing
  • Homework help
  • Small groups

Extra classes

Dance, music, story telling and fun learning after the lessons. Little stars find their talent and shine on stage.

  • Dance
  • Music
  • Story telling
  • Fun learning
